page.layout: One full-page engraving; no printed text blocks. Within the image: the label "Batenburg" on the scaffold, and the plate number "Nº 1." in the lower centre.
page.notes: The page is an engraved plate, not a text page: a crowded street scene with soldiers and pikemen, a timber scaffold in the centre where a man is being beheaded (a headless body lies on the boards, another figure kneels beside it), a crowd behind a palisade, and a small wooden booth with a fire at the left. The only printed words are "Batenburg" (on the scaffold, beside the head) and "Nº 1." (bottom centre). No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
